inspected_2026_10_12.decision: REJECTED - response style would reinforce the targeted failure
inspected_2026_10_12.evidence: 14,624 machine-generated responses; none human-verified. Restricted to 5 low-risk categories and filtered (length <= 1800, no refusal opening, crisis audit): 1,298 candidates, 0 evaluation-leakage hits. But 818/1298 (63%) push 'consult a professional', 89 contain refusal wording mid-response, responses open with a templated 'I notice your query contains...' and prompts in even the low-risk categories mix in harmful framing. Training on these teaches hedged partial-declines, the over-refusal pattern being fixed.
